The '''''Seahawk''''' is a ship, captained by [[Bayle Domon]].

==Activities==
After loosing his former ship, the ''[[Spray]]'', Captain Domon acquires a new ship, the ''Seahawk''. He and [[Egeanin Tamarath]] sail from [[Tanchico]] to [[Cantorin]] aboard the ''Seahawk''.{{ref/book|9|21}}

==Crew==
*Bayle Domon - Captain
*Egeanin Tamarath
